features.title: The professionalism an input method deserves

items.title: Local ASR
items.desc: In-process sherpa-onnx offline recognition. One-click model download with SHA256 verification, resumable transfer, and HF-to-mirror failover.

items.title: Three-tier polish
items.desc: L0 rule-based correction (hotwords, fuzzy pinyin, numeral ITN, S/T Chinese) plus L2 local LLM polish, with graceful passthrough on failure.

items.title: Speech translation
items.desc: Speak Chinese, type another language. Seven base languages, extensible with the MiLMMT-46 local model.

items.title: Hotwords & styles
items.desc: A personal hotword dictionary corrects first; style packs set the tone; "mail:" and "translate:" prefixes jump straight to the task.

items.title: File transcription
items.desc: Long audio auto-segmented and transcribed, exported as timed SRT subtitles.

privacy.title: 0 bytes of audio uploaded
privacy.desc: The default engine runs entirely in-process: sound goes from the microphone into sherpa-onnx, text lands at your cursor, and the network is never involved. Cloud engines are only enabled if you configure them.

diagram.caption: The local pipeline: recognition never leaves the machine

engines.title: Local by default, cloud by choice

download.title: Get the installer from Releases
metaItems: One-click local model download after install

items.a: macOS is fully stable; Windows is in beta — the NSIS installer works, native TSF insertion is in progress.
The default local engine works fully offline; only the first model download needs network. Optional cloud engines require credentials.
With the local engine, audio is recognized in-process on your machine — 0 bytes uploaded.
Open a GitHub issue or send a PR — the project is MIT licensed.
